about.caption: The 5th edition : 15 – 17 of April
about.title: A developer conference in Athens
paragraphs: Devoxx Greece 2027 will take place from April 15 to 17 at the Megaron Athens International Conference Centre.

Devoxx Greece is the evolution of the Voxxed Days Athens conference, and it has become a 3-day conference where developer communities come together to explore the latest technology advancements with some of the most inspiring speakers in our sector.

Diverse local and global talent introduce the latest and most vital content from the development world, with a range of sessions covering Java, Cloud, Big Data, Security, Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, Programming Languages, Methodologies, and Developer Culture.
Devoxx Greece expands your knowledge base, sharpens your skills, and provides hands-on experience with the latest technologies.
about.family: The Devoxx family welcomes annually over 15.000 Devoxxians!

sessions.name: Keynotes
sessions.text: Inspiring and thought-provoking keynotes on Thursday morning and Friday evening.

sessions.name: Conference
sessions.text: 40 minutes sessions on a range of different technologies, practices and methodologies.

sessions.name: Hands-on Labs
sessions.text: 2 hours hands-on sessions where you delve into a specific technology or methodology under expert guidance.

sessions.name: Deep Dive
sessions.text: 3 hours sessions where attendees can rapidly immerse themselves in a subject matter with an in-depth examination of a topic or technology.

sessions.name: Byte Size
sessions.text: 15 minutes sessions designed for speakers to give a quickfire view of a particular subject.

sessions.name: Mentoring Sessions
sessions.text: 15-20-minute round table sessions focused on soft skills, personal branding, career development, public speaking and many more.

tracks.name: Agentic Engineering & Tooling
tracks.text: Multi-agent systems, tool-use, evals, and shipping AI beyond the demo.

tracks.name: Architecture & Modernization
tracks.text: Designing for agentic workflows, event-driven systems, and legacy transformation.

tracks.name: Cloud Native, Data & Infrastructure
tracks.text: Kubernetes, platform engineering, vector DBs, model serving, and GPU orchestration.

tracks.name: Development Practices
tracks.text: All about Getting Stuff Done right. Methodologies, better practices, etc.

tracks.name: Front-end & UX
tracks.text: Web & mobile, performance, accessibility, design systems.

tracks.name: Java Language & Platform
tracks.text: Project Loom, Leyden, Valhalla, Panama, and the evolving JVM.

tracks.name: Mind the Geek
tracks.text: Developer candy: stuff we want to know about but don't (generally) at work, Robotics, biological computing, cybernetics, AI, new toys, tomorrow's technologies.

tracks.name: People, Practices & Career
tracks.text: Leading teams, engineering culture, and career resilience.

tracks.name: Security, Trust & Compliance
tracks.text: Guardrails, prompt injection defense, model governance, and supply-chain security.
